name: @wae/{{name}}-workspace
description: {{nameTitle}} workspace: Rust crates, npm application packages, CLI, skills, and VMZ UI

scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
